title: MTAConfiguration
description: Canonical configuration schema for Menditect Test Automation (MTA) workspace, MCP servers, runtime plugin, and tooling.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema defining this document.

workspace_type.description: Type of workspace where the agent is running.

workspace_dir.description: Absolute path to the active workspace directory.

skills_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing MTA agentic skills.

skills_style.description: Style of skill installation (standard project-level skills/ or Mendix 11.12+ Marketplace module).

mta_output_path.description: Root directory for MTA output artifacts and reports.

execution_plans_dir.description: Directory where active Execution Plans (.md) are stored.

execution_plan_collapsible.description: Whether to format execution plans with collapsible <details> HTML tags (default: true for VS Code/GitHub) or flat Markdown headers (false for Claude Desktop/pure markdown).

execution_plans_archive_dir.description: Deprecated: Execution plans are updated in-place and versioned via Git.

mendix_version.description: Mendix Studio Pro version detected from the project .mpr.

application_name.description: Name of the target Mendix application.

mta_base_url.description: Base URL of the Menditect Test Automation web portal.

mcp_endpoint.description: MCP endpoint URL for the MTA primitive tools server.

mta_auth_header.description: DEPRECATED for local security: Bearer tokens are now stored in .env as MTA_MCP_AUTH_HEADER to prevent credential leakage. Maintained as a fallback for backwards compatibility.

plugin_mcp_url.description: MCP endpoint URL for the MTA local runtime plugin.

plugin_mcp_token.description: DEPRECATED for local security: Plugin access tokens are now stored in .env as PLUGIN_MCP_TOKEN to prevent credential leakage. Maintained as a fallback for backwards compatibility.

playwright_viewer_url.description: Base URL of the Playwright trace viewer web interface (defaults to 'https://trace.playwright.dev/?trace=').

tracefile_base_url.description: Base URL used to retrieve Playwright trace files by FileUUID (e.g. 'https://[mta-or-runtime-domain]/rest/private/tracefile?fileUUID=' or derived from mta_base_url).

app_instances.description: List of discovered or configured application runtime instances.

name.description: Display name of the application instance (e.g. 'mta-trial-1', 'Local Development').

token.description: MTA Application Instance Token (GUID) used by ExecuteTest.

mtaUrl.description: MTA server URL associated with this instance.

runtimeUrl.description: Local or remote Mendix application runtime root URL.

pluginUrl.description: Plugin MCP URL for this instance.

pluginToken.description: Plugin MCP access token for this instance.

pluginPort.description: HTTP port of the plugin MCP server.

tracefileUrl.description: Tracefile retrieval base URL specific to this application instance.

default_app_instance.description: Name of the default application instance to target.

default_app_instance_token.description: Default MTA Application Instance Token used for ExecuteTest calls.

model_source.description: Model discovery mechanism used by the agent ('mxcli' or 'studiopro').

mendix_project_dir.description: Absolute path to the Mendix project directory.

mendix_mpr_path.description: Absolute path to the Mendix project .mpr file.
